title: Rapid cleanup capture: SDK tutorial and sample-app quickwins
content:
Context: quick capture after pairing with Maya and Arjun — focused on fast, shipable fixes for SDK/tutorial sample apps before next sprint demo. This is intentionally terse — notes to self and tiny tasks, not polished copy.

Top-level goals:
- Unblock new users hitting the tutorial by fixing the 404 asset and tightening the quickstart wording (reduce friction).
- Add one fully working minimal sample-app (Next.js + Redwood API usage example) that demonstrates streaming responses + function calling in ~30 lines.
- Close at least 3 doc gaps flagged in DOCS-2217 with inline examples and verified commands.

Quick TODOs (priority ordered):
1) tutorial-index-404 (est. 1.0h) — upstream asset path mismatch for ’/docs/sdk/quickstart/box.gif’. Update link and add fallback text for browsers with adblock.
   - Repro: follow quickstart steps on fresh account; step 4 fails with 404 when rendering gif.
   - Fix: change path in markdown to /assets/tutorials/box-v2.gif and open PR.
   - Acceptance: tutorial page loads in Chrome and Firefox; unit test verifying link exists.

2) sample-app-minimal (est. 3.0h) — create minimal repo under devx-samples/ with instructions: token env var, POST example, streaming handler. Must include: Node example, Python example, and a one-file Next.js demo.
   - Checklist:
     - minimal README with copy-paste commands (npm run dev, export REDWOOD_API_KEY=… )
     - sample uses models/redwood-small (verified) and shows token usage output 
     - add test script that runs the example and asserts response contains expected prefix
   - Linked PR base: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx/pull/489 (branch: sample-app-quickwin)

3) SDK docs: argument types + examples (est. 2.0h) — doc gaps around streaming callbacks and function schema. Add small snippet for TypeScript consumers.
   - Example snippet to add: 
     const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-small', messages: [...] });
     for await (const chunk of stream) { console.log(chunk.delta); }
   - Note: call out older node versions that need flag --experimental-fetch in doc blurb.

4) tutorial troubleshooting section (est. 1.0h) — capture common errors and commands: check env, run health check, `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping`

Notes to self / gotchas:
- People keep copying the example token from the demo UI; remind them to create a new key and rotate. Add small CTA: "Create token (dev)" with link to console.
- Function-calling example needs clearer schema contract: include minimal JSON schema example and show validator error sample.
- Streaming + SSR: add short note that streaming to server-side rendered pages will block unless using edge runtime or client-side streaming. Put this in a single-sentence callout.

Unresolved questions:
- Should the sample-app use webhooks or polling for long-running tasks? (ping Arjun)
- Which example model should be promoted as default in quickstart: redwood-small or redwood-meduim? (ops cost tradeoff — ask Maya)

Immediate steps I will do today:
- Open PR for path fix (task 1) — branch: fix/tutorial-asset-path. (target: 2026-03-14 afternoon)
- Start skeleton repo for sample-app-minimal and push README + Next.js file (task 2) — create GH repo under devx-samples.
- Draft short TypeScript snippet for streaming to paste into docs (task 3).

Estimated total time: ~7h (split across two days).

People to ping: Arjun (samples + infra), Maya (docs sign-off), Remy (CI test addition), Noor (security review for sample tokens).

Quick links to add to PR descriptions (copy-paste ready):
- Confluence checklist: /display/DEVX/SDK+Tutorial+Checklist
- Jira ticket: DOCS-2217 (link in linked_artifacts)
- Slack context: #devx-docs thread (Mar 11)

Random scratch notes (for later cleaning):
- Consider tiny sandbox deploy on Netlify for Next demo so reviewers can click and see live stream.
- Could show cost estimate: "~$0.02 per 1k tokens with redwood-small" — need to confirm with pricing team before publishing.

End of capture. Will tidy into real PR descriptions and small commits.
